<!--
AI may help you write this; unverified content must not be submitted.
可以用 AI 辅助撰写，但提交前须自行核实全部内容。

State each fact once; do not restate the title, diff or template.
同一件事只写一次，不要重复标题、代码改动或模板内容。
No filler, praise, summaries of your own work or emoji.
不写客套话、夸赞和自我总结，不用表情符号。
Paste only relevant log lines; link or collapse long output.
日志只贴相关的几行；较长的输出请附链接或折叠。
Say what you could not verify.
没有验证过的地方请注明。
-->

<!-- Closes #N (if there is a related issue / 如有相关 issue) -->

## Problem / 问题

<!-- One short paragraph: the defect or unmet need.
用一小段说明缺陷或尚未满足的需求。
-->

## How I fixed it / 解决方法

<!-- One short paragraph: how the change addresses it and why.
用一小段说明改了什么，以及为什么这样改。
-->

## Verified / 验证

<!-- Record the applicable CONTRIBUTING.md and CI checks, with commands, environment and observed results. Say what you could not verify. Link long evidence.
列出适用的 CONTRIBUTING.md 和 CI 检查，注明命令、执行环境、结果及未验证的部分。较长的输出请附链接。
-->

---

<!-- Each commit needs an English `type(scope): subject` and a short English body.
每个 commit 都需要英文的 `type(scope): subject` 标题和简短的英文正文。
-->

- [ ] I understand this change and answer for every line / 我理解这项改动，并对每一行负责
- [ ] This branch is based on the current main / 此分支基于当前的 main
- [ ] I ran the repository's gates and recorded the results in Verified / 我执行了仓库要求的检查，并在“验证”中记录了结果
- [ ] Each commit is one coherent change / 每个提交只包含一项完整的改动
- [ ] If behaviour changed, I updated the documentation / 如果行为有变，我已更新文档
- [ ] If interface text changed, I updated the affected Android string resources and translations / 如果界面文案有变，我已更新相应的 Android 字符串资源和译文
- [ ] If interface appearance changed, I attached light and dark screenshots / 如果界面外观有变，我已附上浅色和深色模式的截图
- [ ] I checked the boxes above without reading them / 我没有阅读上面的选项就直接勾选了
- [ ] I am an AI agent, and this content was submitted without human review / 我是 AI 代理，这些内容没有经过人工审核

Check only true claims. An applicable unchecked box or a false claim closes the pull request.

只勾选属实的选项。适用的选项没有勾选，或勾选的内容不属实，PR 会被关闭。
